name: Moongipa Capital Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Moongipa 
Capital Finance Ltd is engaged
in investment, trading, and 
credit activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MFCL is registered as a non systematically important non-deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company, which is classified as an NBFC – Investment and Credit Company (NBFC-ICC). It is in the business:
a) Investment and trading in securities, equity shares, preference shares, stocks, debentures (convertible and non-convertible) of listed and unlisted Companies
b) It also deals in Government Securities, including Government Bonds, Loans, units, 
and all other Financial Instruments and providing retail loans and advances for industrial and other purpose
c) The company provides unsecured 
financing (Corporate and Personal 
Finance)

pros: Stock is trading at 0.64 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.29% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 23.9 to 50.7 days.
Working capital days have increased from 450 days to 876 days
